observation.command: cd /workspace && echo "=== config inside container matches host ===" && docker exec workspace-tika-1 cat /etc/open_taki/config.yaml | diff - /workspace/taki-config.yaml && echo "IDENTICAL" && echo "=== restart/uptime ===" && docker inspect workspace-tika-1 --format 'RestartCount={{.RestartCount}} Started={{.State.StartedAt}} Policy={{.HostConfig.RestartPolicy.Name}}' && echo "=== listening port ===" && (ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep 9998 || curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'health HTTP:%{http_code}\n' http://localhost:9998/) && echo "=== Tika-compat content-type header ===" && curl -sS -D - -o /dev/null -X PUT -H 'Content-Type: text/plain' --data 'x' http://localhost:9998/rmeta/text | grep -i '^content-type'
